@app.command()
def registre(
    kind: str | None = typer.Option(None, "--kind", help="Limite l'affichage à ce kind."),
) -> None:
    """Liste les Composants et Architectures enregistrés."""
    try:
        registry.discover()
        entrees = registry.list_components(kind=kind)
    except ConfigError as erreur:
        typer.echo(str(erreur), err=True)
        raise typer.Exit(2) from erreur
    if not entrees:
        typer.echo("Aucun Composant enregistré.")
        return
    for entree in entrees:
        typer.echo(f"{entree.kind} / {entree.name}")
        if entree.description:
            for ligne in entree.description.splitlines():
                typer.echo(f"  {ligne}")
        if not entree.params:
            typer.echo("  Params : aucun")
            continue
        typer.echo("  Params :")
        for p in entree.params.values():
            valeur = "(obligatoire)" if p.required else repr(p.default)
            typer.echo(f"    {p.name} : {p.type} = {valeur}")

"""Tests du registre de Composants."""

from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict

from wavelibrarian import architectures, components, registry
from wavelibrarian.core.errors import ConfigError
from wavelibrarian.registry import get, list_components, register


class _ParamsOk(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
    size: int = 300
    obligatoire: str


def _definir_toy() -> type:
    @register("chunker", "toy")
    class Toy:
        """Un chunker de test.

        Deuxième ligne.
        """

        class Params(BaseModel):
            model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
            size: int = 300

    return Toy


def test_enregistrement_et_liste() -> None:
    toy = _definir_toy()
    assert get("chunker", "toy") is toy
    (info,) = list_components(kind="chunker")
    assert (info.kind, info.name) == ("chunker", "toy")
    assert info.description == "Un chunker de test.\n\nDeuxième ligne."
    p = info.params["size"]
    assert (p.type, p.default, p.required) == ("int", 300, False)


def test_param_obligatoire() -> None:
    @register("chunker", "o")
    class O:
        Params = _ParamsOk

    p = list_components()[0].params["obligatoire"]
    assert p.required and p.default is None


def test_kind_invalide() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ConfigError) as exc:
        register("bidule", "x")(type("X", (), {}))
    assert exc.value.path == "bidule"
    assert "chunker" in str(exc.value)


def test_doublon() -> None:
    _definir_toy()
    with pytest.raises(ConfigError) as exc:
        _definir_toy()
    assert exc.value.path == "chunker.toy"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "config", [ConfigDict(extra="forbid"), ConfigDict(frozen=True), ConfigDict()]
)
def test_params_non_conformes(config: ConfigDict) -> None:
    class Mauvais(BaseModel):
        model_config = config

    cls = type("X", (), {"Params": Mauvais})
    with pytest.raises(ConfigError) as exc:
        register("chunker", "x")(cls)
    assert exc.value.path == "chunker.x"


def test_nom_inconnu() -> None:
    register("chunker", "toy")(type("A", (), {}))
    register("chunker", "toy2")(type("B", (), {}))
    register("embedder", "autre")(type("C", (), {}))
    with pytest.raises(ConfigError) as exc:
        get("chunker", "inconnu")
    assert exc.value.path == "chunker.inconnu"
    assert "toy, toy2" in str(exc.value)
    assert "autre" not in str(exc.value)


def test_aucun_nom_pour_le_kind() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ConfigError, match="aucun Composant enregistré pour reranker"):
        get("reranker", "x")


def test_decouverte_idempotente(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    (tmp_path / "toy_mod.py").write_text(
        "from wavelibrarian.registry import register\n\n"
        "@register('chunker', 'decouvert')\nclass D:\n    pass\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(components, "__path__", [*components.__path__, str(tmp_path)])
    monkeypatch.setattr(architectures, "__path__", list(architectures.__path__))
    registry.discover()
    assert get("chunker", "decouvert").__name__ == "D"
    registry.discover()
    assert len(list_components(kind="chunker")) == 1
EOF

"""Tests de la commande `wl registre`."""

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict
from typer.testing import CliRunner

from wavelibrarian.cli import app
from wavelibrarian.registry import register

runner = CliRunner()


def _remplir() -> None:
    @register("chunker", "toy")
    class Toy:
        """Chunker jouet."""

        class Params(BaseModel):
            model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)
            size: int = 300

    @register("embedder", "x")
    class X:
        """Embedder jouet."""


def test_toutes_les_entrees() -> None:
    _remplir()
    r = runner.invoke(app, ["registre"])
    assert r.exit_code == 0
    assert "chunker / toy" in r.output and "embedder / x" in r.output
    assert "Chunker jouet." in r.output
    assert "size : int = 300" in r.output
    assert "Params : aucun" in r.output


def test_filtre_kind() -> None:
    _remplir()
    r = runner.invoke(app, ["registre", "--kind", "chunker"])
    assert r.exit_code == 0
    assert "toy" in r.output and "embedder" not in r.output


def test_registre_vide() -> None:
    r = runner.invoke(app, ["registre"])
    assert r.exit_code == 0
    assert "Aucun Composant enregistré." in r.output


def test_kind_invalide() -> None:
    r = runner.invoke(app, ["registre", "--kind", "bidule"])
    assert r.exit_code == 2
    assert "bidule" in r.output
EOF
